analysis.title: No More Teflon Tech
key_insights: NDX was down more than 5% at the time of writing, breaking below its range lows and the longer-term trend line and trading well below the 200-day MA.
NDX volatility is rising toward the panic highs seen around Liberation Day, both outright and relative to VIX, while VIX also surged on the day.
GS data shows $5.1bn of non-dealer Nasdaq futures selling between October 20 and 27, ending three consecutive weeks of buying. Net length was still at the 96th percentile on a two-year lookback.

Nasdaq fell 5.6% between October 27 and November 2 while futures open interest rose $16.3bn. October 30 alone added $14.3bn, the largest daily increase of 2026 outside roll periods. GS reads this as aggressive new short selling.

Nasdaq rebounded 1.6% between November 2 and 4 while open interest fell $4.1bn and Nasdaq funding recovered relative to SPX. The note reads this as short covering rather than renewed bullish conviction.
The crowded AI trade continues to unwind, with relative winners emerging outside the AI complex.
The Market Ear's long Apple 'anti-AI' trade continues to work. Apple versus NVDA has worked better than Apple versus NDX.

market_movers.rationale: The long Apple anti-AI trade continues to deliver and Apple is outperforming NDX. Expressing it as long Apple versus NVDA has worked even better.

sector_views.rationale: The AI complex is unwinding from crowded positioning. The note advises being selective within tech rather than abandoning it.

trade_ideas.rationale: The anti-AI trade has worked, and Apple versus NVDA has outperformed Apple versus NDX.
